faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IKSV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IKSV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Guest Lecturer - Graphics.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IKSV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the Dean, Faculty of Visual Arts, Indira Kala Sangeet Vishwavidyalaya, Khairagarh (Chhattisgarh), by by hand or post, to reach by 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per Chhattisgarh Government Higher Education Department rules and Guest Lecturer Policy 2024 (amended 2026).

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Appointments are made for teaching arrangement for the academic session 2026-27 until the examination concludes or regular appointments are made, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications by a committee of senior teachers. Recommendation of selection by the committee. Approval by the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor. Selection based on guidelines specified in Chhattisgarh Government Higher Education Department Guest Lecturer Policy 2024 (amended 2026).

faq.question: Q7. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary guest lecturer arrangement until completion of academic session 2026-27 or regular appointment.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Khairagarh.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Self-attested photocopies of all original certificates and mark sheets.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number of this recruitment?
faq.answer: It is Advt No. 480/I.K.S.Vi.Vi.(Estha.)/2026-27/Guest Lecturer/Advt..
